div.div: p0/p1 = BC1 slave/master ports (same NIC), p4/p5 = BC2 slave/master ports (same NIC, different from BC1), p2/p3 = the grandmaster's 2 ports (same node, same NIC). Each GM port is directly connected to one BC slave port.
